about: The spoken script of the film. tools/voice.py turns it into audio/lines/*.wav and audio/narration.json. 'text' is what the caption shows; 'spoken' (optional) is what the voice engine is given when the two differ. 'caption': 'screen' marks a line said inside a product screen (Draft 3's made-up Zoom meeting, m1 to m4): the screen shows it as the app's own captions and the film's captions leave it out.
